title: Glyphsmith — Pocket Type Foundry
description: Draw skeleton letterforms, dial weight/width/slant/contrast, and download a real .ttf the browser will install.
concept: A type foundry that fits in one HTML file. Every letter is stored as a centre-line skeleton, so the weight, width, slant, contrast and terminal-shape axes reshape all 56 glyphs at once instead of just one. You can drag nodes, draw new strokes with the pen, retune sidebearings per glyph, then export a byte-for-byte valid TrueType file — head, hmtx, cmap format 4, glyf, the whole directory — assembled in the page with no font library. The 'Preview in real font' button feeds those same bytes to FontFace so you can watch the browser shape live text with a typeface you just drew.
features: Skeleton editor: drag nodes, drag whole strokes, pen tool for new strokes, per-node erase, per-glyph revert
Five global variation axes — weight, width, slant, contrast and tracking — that re-cut every glyph live
Terminal shapes (round / flat / wedge) plus a stencil-gap axis that cuts breaks through every stroke
Seven presets from Hairline to Black, Stencil, Condensed and Backslant
Per-glyph advance width, stroke-weight multiplier and adjustable cap height with live metric guides
Export a real .ttf built in-page from raw bytes, and install it via FontFace to proof live HTML text
Save/open .json projects, copy a shareable URL-hash link, and autosave to localStorage
tech: Canvas 2D + Path2D (nonzero fill matches TrueType winding)
FontFace API for live installation of the generated font
Catmull-Rom sampling with normal-offset stroke expansion and miter-limited joins
Pointer Events, Blob downloads, URL-hash sharing, localStorage

interaction.mouse: Drag nodes to reshape a letter, or drag a stroke to move it whole; sliders re-cut the entire alphabet.
interaction.click: Pick a glyph from the rail, tap the pen to drop new nodes, or hit Export .ttf to download the font.
interaction.touch: Every gesture is pointer-based — drag nodes, tap to place pen nodes, swipe the glyph rail.
interaction.keyboard: V move · P pen · E erase · O outline · R revert · Enter finish stroke · type any letter to jump to it
